POPULATION EFFECTS: Strong subgroup effect based on KRAS mutation status - wild-type KRAS patients showed significant PFS difference compared to mutant KRAS, which aligns with known mechanism of EGFR inhibitor resistance. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major confounders identified - appropriate sample size (74), reasonable duration (152 weeks), and safety profile consistent with known panitumumab effects.
